ads.title: Ads
ads.intro: Promote your own or resold products across the marketplace. You pay per click; campaigns stop when the budget runs out.
ads.emptyText: Ads appear on the marketplace home page for shoppers.

content.title: Creator studio
content.intro: Generate posts, captions and short-video scripts for any product you sell. Published posts appear in the creator feed with a shoppable link that credits your shop.
content.offline: AI is in offline template mode. Add {key} to the backend {env} to enable Claude-written content.

assistant.intro: Your business co-pilot for {shop}. It reads your real data and can save drafts — you stay in control of anything that goes live.
assistant.placeholder: Ask about sales, stock, sell-staff, or ask for content…
